A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-mournfulroar-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Mournful Roar (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text now reads: “Deploy on Chewie if Han was just lost or just became missing. Opponent cannot play Let The Wookiee Win or Wookiee Roar. Opponent must also lose 1 Force at end of every player’s turn. If Han on table, Immediate Effect canceled.” This is a slip: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title. The card type reads “IMMEDIATE EFFECT” again, and the last sentence says “Immediate Effect canceled”.

The earlier slip and this slip as cut from the sheets at 300 dpi, the second scaled to the size of the first; nothing else is edited.
